identificationModule.briefTitle: Systemic Chemotherapy Versus Transcatheter Arterial Chemoembolization(TACE) for Hepatocellular Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Systemic Chemotherapy VersusTranscatheter Arterial Chemoembolization As Palliative Chemotherapy in Patients With Advanced Hepatocellular Carcinoma(HCC)

statusModule.whyStopped: It doesn't meet the requirements of randomized trials

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to determine that systemic chemotherapy is superior to transcatheter arterial chemoembolization in prolonging progression-free survival（PFS） in patients with Advanced Hepatocellular Carcinoma.

armGroups.label: systemic chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Pirarubicin 30mg/m2 intravenously on Day 1 and Oxaliplatin 100 mg/m2 intravenously on Day 2 every 3 weeks until disease progression or limiting toxicity.

armGroups.label: Transcatheter Arterial Chemoembolization
armGroups.description: Lipiodol 5-10ml,Pirarubicin17mg/m2 and Oxaliplatin 30mg/m2 are infused through the right and left hepatic arteries,followed by embolization using Gelfoam every 4 weeks until disease progression or limiting toxicity.

interventions.name: Pirarubicin
interventions.description:
1. Pirarubicin 30mg/m2 intravenously
2. Pirarubicin17mg/m2 are infused through the right and left hepatic arteries

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description:
1. Oxaliplatin 100 mg/m2 intravenously
2. Oxaliplatin 30mg/m2 are infused through the right and left hepatic arteries

interventions.name: Lipiodol
interventions.description: Lipiodol 5-10ml infused through the right and left hepatic arteries
